_meta.description: Real Ramp (corporate-card / spend mgmt; api.ramp.com) webhook delivery. Flat event object: root-level business_id is the tenant key, `type` is dot.notation, `object.id` is the affected resource, `id` is the stable event id (constant across retries). NO eventNotifications wrapper. Doc-derived; values are placeholders. NOTE: X-Ramp-Signature is HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, but hex-vs-base64 is NOT documented upstream (our base64 assumption is unverified — confirm against a real delivery).
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/guides/webhooks (root business_id; X-Ramp-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of raw body; payload id/type/created_at/business_id/object)

headers.X-Ramp-Signature: <HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed by the per-subscription secret; encoding hex-or-base64 UNCONFIRMED upstream; the contract test recomputes it base64 to match the current verifier>
